Grokkun export folder
=====================

Standalone Windows/Linux binaries are produced with Godot export templates.

This package was built without official export templates installed, so no
binaries were baked here. Open the project in Godot 4.7+ and:

  Editor -> Manage Export Templates -> Download
  Project -> Export -> Linux  -> dist/Grokkun.x86_64
  Project -> Export -> Windows Desktop -> dist/Grokkun.exe

Presets live in ../export_presets.cfg.
